title: Text in button states has no embedded font reference — always device-font sized
description: encodeDefineButton2 in buttons.ts calls encodeDefineEditText(cid, obj) without a fontCharId at line ~206. This sets HasFont=0, so text inside button states has no font size reference and Ruffle falls back to a default size. The main-timeline text pre-pass in compile.ts correctly resolves font char IDs via fontCharIdMap, but this map is not passed to encodeDefineButton2. Fix: add a fontCharIdMap parameter to encodeDefineButton2 and pass the font ID lookup to encodeDefineEditText for text objects inside buttons.
